correctness.rationale: Reconstructed allowed path-subgraphs directly from 20 directed arcs. All 710 nonempty faces are exhausted by sizes (20,130,320,240); exact signed chain compositions vanish. Unimodular unit-pivot eliminations give d1 rank19 with only units, d2 rank111 with only units, and d3 208 unit pivots plus rank-one residual gcd2, all its 2×2 minors zero: Smith factors (1^208,2). Thus H~2=Z/2 and H~3=Z^31. Independently enumerated oriented fixed-simplex traces for seven S5 cycle types with/without hub swap, exactly (31,1),(-5,-3),(-1,1),(1,1),(1,-3),(-1,1),(1,1); the ordinary Specht decomposition gives 16-dimensional + and 15-dimensional − sectors, no S5-fixed class. These computations are exhaustive because every eligible simplex has ≤4 arrows, not a finite approximation of an infinite claim.
residual_risks: Exactly 20 arcs/4-dimensional face bound only; no other leaf counts verified.
The rational Specht character follows from oriented Lefschetz, not from integer Smith form alone.
